users_tier_matches_role.name: users_tier_matches_role
users_tier_matches_role.value: ("users"."role" IN ('RESELLER', 'CUSTOMER') AND "users"."price_tier_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("users"."role" = 'ADMIN' AND "users"."price_tier_id" IS NULL)

sales_order_funding_check.name: sales_order_funding_check
sales_order_funding_check.value:
("sales_order"."buyer_kind" = 'RESELLER' AND "sales_order"."wallet_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_order"."provider_account_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("sales_order"."buyer_kind" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "sales_order"."wallet_entry_id" IS NULL AND "sales_order"."provider_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
